label: text
text: While many will subscribe to Spofford's appreciation of McDonald, the view that the Sussex' professional is second to anyone will not be generally accepted, especially in the South. This season will be the first in which McDonald is available for the whole period, and if the summer is anything like dry, the value of his much-winning fast bowling for Bancashire cannot be overestimated, for his pace provides a great contrast to Richard Yldesley's accurately pitched leg spinners and the mixture as served by Cecil Parkie. text: There were some very surprising results in the bowls games on Saturday.

label: text
text: In the First Division, playing on their own ground the K.B.G. disposed of the Taikoo team by thirty points. At the Dock Club ground Craigengower gained an unexpected victory over the home team by sixteen points. The Civil Service again proved that they are a team to be reckoned with, for playing on their own ground they secured an overwhelming victory over the Kowloon Cricket Club by fifty points.

label: text
text: The results in the second Division did not contain any surprises. Taikoo just managed to win against the Indian Recreation Club by one point, although the latter were leading by five at the eighteenth head. The Police continued their sequence of victories, and the K.C.C. second string secured the points at the expense of the East Point Club.

Brodhead, Managing Director of the foreign department of Colgate & Co., with a party from that house, is on a visit and arrived to-day. The name Colgate is known the world over, due mainly to Mr. Brodhead's efforts. The house of Colgate is the largest manufacturer of Toilet Soaps, Toilet Preparations, and Perfumes in the world.
Mr. Brodhead's presence should enhance further the reputation of the house he represents. Mr. Brodhead has been extending his visits so that, with this trip behind him, his preaching the doctrine of cleanliness and good health will be world wide.

label: text
text: Mr. Brodhead has been associated with Col's gate & Co. for the past thirty-six years. Touching on world connotations, Mr. Brodhead said in an interview that he found during recent trips that conditions show considerable improvement. "Of course," he added, "It is difficult to notice a change within a couple of weeks. Improvement is more perceptible when one travels at intervals of one and two years." Messrs. Hongkong Trading Co., Ltd. are the sole agents of Colgate & Co. for Hongkong and South China.
